front.title: Post-Quantum and Multi-Tenant Extensions to X.509 Certificate Discovery
front.workgroup: Limited Additional Mechanisms for PKIX and SMIME

abstract.t: This document extends the X.509 certificate discovery mechanism with post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) algorithm capability advertisement, hybrid-pair locator records, and tenant-isolated discovery namespaces. The extensions enable a multi-tenant Certification Authority (CA) to publish per-tenant PQC algorithm sets without leaking neighbor-tenant inventory.
The extensions are backward-compatible with the base certificate discovery mechanism. Tenant carve-out implementation parameters are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: Certificate discovery enables relying parties to locate certificates by subject, issuer, or algorithm capability. Multi-tenant CAs need to expose PQC capability per tenant without exposing the aggregate inventory of all tenants. This document defines the necessary discovery extensions.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD", "MAY" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: PQC Capability Advertisement
section.t: Discovery responders MAY advertise a pqcCapability set containing supported ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA parameter sets, expressed as OBJECT IDENTIFIERs.

section.name: Hybrid-Pair Locator Records
section.t: A hybridPairLocator record binds a classical certificate to its post-quantum companion certificate or to a composite certificate chain. Relying parties MAY use the locator to fetch the companion artifact in a single round trip.

section.name: Tenant-Isolated Namespaces
section.t: Discovery responders compliant with this document MUST scope responses to the requesting tenant context. The concrete carve-out parameters and namespace partition implementation are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: PQC capability and hybrid-pair locators are sensitive metadata. Responders SHOULD authenticate requesters and rate-limit cross-tenant discovery probes.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: IANA is requested to allocate object identifiers under the appropriate PKIX arc for pqcCapability and hybridPairLocator attributes.
